Loss report: gitlab -> drone
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.schedule: trigger event cron with the cron job name (Drone keeps the schedule in the repo settings: run drone cron add <repo> gitlab-ci-schedule-0 "")
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/nightly job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/nightly/step/script step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Drone pipes commands to /bin/sh, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
